title: NHDF v0.3 general-purpose continuous collision detection profile

kernel_stage_mapping.C_in_E_LP_A_B_X_xi_B0_P_C_phi_R_BST_K_T: base NHDF conditioning, addressing, zero-set, predicates, routing, and motion
kernel_stage_mapping.B_CCD_D_CCD_T_TOI_M_C_R_C: optional CCD candidate, dispatch, certified event, manifold, and response stages

mappings.typed: NHDF/PCKF/IHCP plus typed CCD query and certificate records
mappings.vector: body motion, contact witnesses, normals, relative velocity
mappings.kinematic: forward trajectories and declared numerical integration
mappings.geometry: implicit fields, conservative bounds, candidate pairs, contact manifolds
mappings.topology: base chart/orientation semantics; topology does not replace collision certificates
mappings.packing: base log-polar LUT may prioritize or index but does not replace geometry
mappings.predicate: exact, inclusion, interval, or controlled conservative event certificate
mappings.operator: CCD stages compose inside the surrounding NHDF chain
mappings.self_reference: contact output and residual enter explicit next-generation U/H update

evidence_requirements.claim: The application maps the K1-K15 profile requirements.
evidence_requirements.method: Bind every K1-K15 item to an implemented or explicit bypass mapping.
evidence_requirements.pass_condition: Every item has one non-contradictory mapping and sealed evidence reference.

evidence_requirements.claim: The CCD C/B/N/R/P requirement families are mapped explicitly.
evidence_requirements.method: Record typed candidate, bound, numeric, response, and policy mappings.
evidence_requirements.pass_condition: Every selected requirement family is implemented or explicitly bypassed with rationale.

evidence_requirements.claim: Geometry, motion, and numeric backend support are declared as a finite matrix.
evidence_requirements.method: Enumerate each tested combination and its disposition.
evidence_requirements.pass_condition: The matrix is finite, typed, and contains no implicit unsupported combination.

evidence_requirements.claim: CCD event decisions are backed by a bounded certificate corpus.
evidence_requirements.method: Replay declared positive, negative, and indeterminate certificate cases.
evidence_requirements.pass_condition: Every corpus case has a deterministic disposition and evidence path.

evidence_requirements.claim: CCD candidates, subdivisions, iterations, contacts, and runtime reserve stay bounded.
evidence_requirements.method: Record declared limits and observed use for each resource.
evidence_requirements.pass_condition: All observed values remain within limits or fail closed explicitly.
